Capability ID: audit-center-website-audit-machine-v1
Commercial state: sell_now
Machine state: human_handoff_ready
Public URL: https://fabric.systemiacommandcenters.com/capabilities/audit-center-website-audit-machine-v1

Start here: Not a current sell-now route

## Use this when

- why is my website not getting leads
- audit my website
- why is my contractor website not ranking
- check my local SEO
- why is my site slow on mobile
- find conversion problems on my website
- review my website SEO
- tell me what is wrong with my business website
- my website gets traffic but nobody contacts us
- people visit my site but do not contact me
- why is my website not converting
- website traffic but no leads
- visitors are not turning into leads

## Problem

A small business or contractor needs evidence-backed website triage across performance, technical SEO, local SEO and trust/conversion before spending money fixing the wrong things.

## Inputs

Website/domain. Business name, city, industry and Google Business Profile context improve local and trust checks.

## Outputs

Free preview. The $49 Quick Win Audit delivers a human-reviewed public-website evidence report with five prioritized fixes by email after provider-verified payment. Complete Audit and Audit + Patch remain separately scoped.

## Pricing

Free preview. Quick Win Audit $49 one-time via Stripe-hosted checkout, with a human-reviewed report after verified payment; the $49 may be credited toward a separately agreed Complete Audit. Complete Audit $500 one-time. Audit + Patch $1,200 one-time.

- Free Preview: $0 (free)

- Quick Win Audit: $49 (one_time)

- Complete Audit: $500 (one_time)

- Audit + Patch: $1,200 (one_time)

## Invocation and authority

OWNED BUYER PAGE: $49 Stripe-hosted checkout and a separate free consented inquiry are provided. Native Evercraft checkout is held; report fulfillment is human-reviewed after verified payment. No automatic or machine-fulfilled report release is currently evidenced.

The free preview creates no payment obligation. A buyer must explicitly choose the Stripe-hosted $49 checkout. Evercraft verifies the provider-paid receipt; the report is then human-reviewed and delivered by email. Native checkout and automatic fulfillment are not verified. Complete Audit and Audit + Patch require a separate agreed scope.

Payment authority: Evercraft Payments; Stripe-hosted settlement. Native payment remains held, and no paid status is claimed without matching provider evidence.

Discovery does not create a payment obligation. Human confirmation is required before checkout where checkout exists. Checkout creation is not proof of payment.
